cards.verse_text: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.
cards.snippet: …Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.

cards.snippet: So in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city, Ephron the Hittite…

cards.card_text: Abraham weighs out the ___ price Ephron named, with the Hittites listening.
cards.verse_text: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants.
cards.snippet: …for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants.

cards.card_text: Ephron's field at Machpelah near Mamre and the cave in it are deeded over to him in front of all the Hittites at the city gate.
cards.verse_text: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants.
cards.snippet: …for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the standard of the merchants.

cards.card_text: It's in the field Abraham had bought from the Hittites.
cards.verse_text: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite.
cards.snippet: …Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite.

cards.card_text: And when Esau, Isaac's son, is forty years old, he marries two Hittite women, Judith and Basemath.
cards.verse_text: When Esau was forty years old, he took as his wives Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite and Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.
cards.snippet: …years old, he took as his wives Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite and Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.

cards.card_text: That cave is in the field near Mamre, which Abraham had purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.

cards.snippet: …in the field near Mamre, which Abraham had purchased from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.

cards.card_text: God will bring them up to a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey, the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
cards.snippet: …land, a land flowing with milk and honey—the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

cards.card_text: A land flowing with milk and honey, home to the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: And when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites—the land He swore to your fathers that He would give you, a land flowing with milk and honey—you shall keep this service in this month.
cards.snippet: And when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites, and Jebusites—the land He swore to your fathers that He…

cards.card_text: Then God names the land His angel will bring them into: the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: For My angel will go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.
cards.snippet: …go before you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will annihilate them.

cards.card_text: What does God send before Israel to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of the way?
cards.verse_text: I will send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.
cards.snippet: …send the hornet before you to drive the Hivites and Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.

cards.card_text: God says He will send an angel ahead of them and drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: And I will send an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
cards.snippet: …an angel before you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says, "Observe what I command you this day." And He promises, "I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites."
cards.verse_text: I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
cards.snippet: I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

cards.card_text: Then they run down who lives where: Amalekites in the Negev, Hittites, Jebusites and Amorites in the hill country, and Canaanites by the sea and along the Jordan.
cards.verse_text: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan.”
cards.snippet: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live…

cards.card_text: He says the LORD will drive out many nations before them: the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: When the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you—
cards.snippet: …are entering to possess, and He drives out before you many nations—the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger…

cards.card_text: Moses names them: the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: For you must devote them to complete destruction—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—as the LORD your God has commanded you,
cards.snippet: For you must devote them to complete destruction—the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—as the LORD your God has commanded…

cards.card_text: Then the LORD lays out the borders: from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and west as far as the Great Sea.
cards.verse_text: Your territory shall extend from the wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates—all the land of the Hittites—and west as far as the Great Sea.
cards.snippet: …wilderness and Lebanon to the great River Euphrates—all the land of the Hittites—and west as far as the Great Sea.

cards.card_text: Joshua calls everybody in to hear the words of the LORD their God: here's how you'll know the living God is among you and will surely drive out the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: So Joshua told the Israelites, “Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God.” He continued, “This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that He will surely drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.
cards.snippet: …you and that He will surely drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites.

cards.card_text: Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, Jebusites: every one of their kings hears it.
cards.verse_text: Now when news of this reached all the kings west of the Jordan—those in the hill country, the foothills, and all along the coast of the Great Sea toward Lebanon (the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites)—
cards.snippet: …and all along the coast of the Great Sea toward Lebanon (the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites)—

cards.card_text: Out west, the land runs from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, hill country, foothills, wilderness and the Negev, the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: And these are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered beyond the Jordan to the west, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (according to the allotments to the tribes of Israel, Joshua gave them as an inheritance the hill country, the foothills, the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites): the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Bethel, one; the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one; the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one; the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one; the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one; the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one; the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one; the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one; the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one; the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one; the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one; the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one; the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one; the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one; the king of Dor in Naphath-dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one; and the king of Tirzah, one.
cards.snippet: …the Arabah, the slopes, the wilderness, and the Negev—the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites): the king of Jericho, one; the…

cards.card_text: Then Israel crosses the Jordan and comes to Jericho, and Jericho fights them, along with the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites and more.
cards.verse_text: The people of Jericho fought against you, as did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I delivered them into your hand.
cards.snippet: …people of Jericho fought against you, as did the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I delivered them into your hand.

cards.verse_text: And the man went to the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.
cards.snippet: And the man went to the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called it Luz, which is its name to…

cards.card_text: So the Israelites keep living among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.
cards.verse_text: Thus the Israelites continued to live among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
cards.snippet: Thus the Israelites continued to live among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

cards.card_text: David turns to Ahimelech the Hittite (not Ahimelech the priest) and Abishai son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother.
cards.verse_text: And David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, “Who will go down with me to Saul in the camp?” “I will go with you,” answered Abishai.
cards.snippet: And David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, “Who will go down with…

cards.verse_text: So David sent and inquired about the woman, and he was told, “This is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite.”
cards.snippet: …is Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam and the wife of Uriah the Hittite.”

cards.card_text: David sends orders to Joab: 'Send me Uriah the Hittite.' When Uriah arrives, David asks how Joab and the troops are doing and how the war is going.
cards.verse_text: At this, David sent orders to Joab: “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” So Joab sent him to David.
cards.snippet: At this, David sent orders to Joab: “Send me Uriah the Hittite.” So Joab sent him to David.

cards.card_text: Joab tells the messenger that if King David gets angry about how close they fought to the wall, he should say, 'Your servant ___ the Hittite is dead as well.' Uriah Eliam Abishai
cards.verse_text: Why did you get so close to the wall?’ If he asks you this, then you are to say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead as well.’”
cards.snippet: …asks you this, then you are to say, ‘Your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead as well.’”

cards.card_text: Without waiting for the king to ask, he adds, 'And your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead as well.'
cards.verse_text: And your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead as well.”
cards.snippet: And your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead as well.”

cards.card_text: He put Uriah the Hittite to the sword and took his wife as his own.
cards.verse_text: You put Uriah the Hittite to the sword and took his wife as your own.
cards.snippet: You put Uriah the Hittite to the sword and took his wife as your own.

cards.card_text: The very last name is Uriah the Hittite, Bathsheba's husband, whose death David arranged (2 Samuel 11:3, 14-17).
cards.verse_text: Now these were members of the Thirty: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem, Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite, Helez the Paltite, Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite, Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite, Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the Benjamites, Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai from the brooks of Gaash, Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan son of Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam son of Sharar the Hararite, Eliphelet son of Ahasbai the Maacathite, Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite, Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite, Igal son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite, Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah, Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite, and Uriah the Hittite.
cards.snippet: …son of Zeruiah, Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite, and Uriah the Hittite.

cards.card_text: These are the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites left in the land, the ones the Israelites were unable to devote to destruction.
cards.verse_text: As for all the people who remained of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites (the people who were not Israelites)— their descendants who remained in the land, those whom the Israelites were unable to devote to destruction—Solomon conscripted these people to be forced laborers, as they are to this day.
cards.snippet: As for all the people who remained of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites (the people who were not Israelites)— their descendants…

cards.card_text: His horses come in from Egypt and Kue, and chariots and horses go out again to the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.
cards.verse_text: Likewise, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Aram.
cards.snippet: Likewise, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Aram.

cards.card_text: Along with the daughter of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, there are women of Moab, Ammon, Edom and Sidon, plus Hittite women.
cards.verse_text: King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women along with the daughter of Pharaoh—women of Moab, Ammon, Edom, and Sidon, as well as Hittite women.
cards.snippet: …daughter of Pharaoh—women of Moab, Ammon, Edom, and Sidon, as well as Hittite women.

cards.card_text: David never turned aside from the LORD's commands, except in the matter of ___ the Hittite.
cards.verse_text: For David had done what was right in the eyes of the LORD and had not turned aside from anything the LORD commanded all the days of his life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
cards.snippet: …the days of his life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

cards.card_text: The Arameans tell each other the king of Israel must have hired the kings of the Hittites and Egyptians, so at twilight they run for their lives.
cards.verse_text: For the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army, so that they said to one another, “Look, the king of Israel must have hired the kings of the Hittites and Egyptians to attack us.” Thus the Arameans had arisen and fled at twilight, abandoning their tents and horses and donkeys.
cards.snippet: …“Look, the king of Israel must have hired the kings of the Hittites and Egyptians to attack us.” Thus the Arameans had arisen and fled…

cards.card_text: Then comes the long roll call of the mighty men, from Asahel the brother of Joab down to Jaasiel the Mezobaite, with names like Zelek the Ammonite, Ithmah the Moabite and Uriah the Hittite.

cards.snippet: …Joab son of Zeruiah, Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite, Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai, Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, chief of…

cards.card_text: Solomon gathers 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses, with a horse and chariot trade reaching from Egypt and Kue out to the kings of the Hittites and Aram.
cards.verse_text: Likewise, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Aram.
cards.snippet: Likewise, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of Aram.

cards.card_text: They say those peoples have abominations like those of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians and more.
cards.verse_text: After these things had been accomplished, the leaders approached me and said, “The people of Israel, including the priests and Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the surrounding peoples whose abominations are like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.
cards.snippet: …from the surrounding peoples whose abominations are like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians, and Amorites.

cards.card_text: God says her father was an Amorite and her mother a Hittite, two peoples who lived in Canaan.
cards.verse_text: Your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.
cards.snippet: Your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

cards.card_text: Then God lays out the family tree: 'Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.'
cards.verse_text: Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
cards.snippet: Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
